title: Parcel was handed to the wrong address and the carrier located it

plan.situation: Plover Arc Logistics' delivery investigations team says DL-026 was handed over at the wrong stop. They have found the sealed parcel at that address and say only their recovery team may see the other household's contact details. Neris Fawn, the intended recipient, wrote in through the Customer portal. She asks the carrier to collect the parcel and deliver it to her verified address, and she does not want to contact the other household herself. No collection or redelivery has been arranged yet.

facts.fact: DL-026 was handed over at the wrong stop
Carrier contacted the wrong address using carrier records and located the sealed parcel
Third-party contact details are restricted to the carrier's recovery team
Neris Fawn requests carrier recovery and delivery to her verified address and does not want to contact the other household
No collection date, recovery scan or redelivery has been recorded yet

missing_information: Carrier's collection date/time from the wrong address
Carrier's redelivery date to the verified address
Recovery scan confirming the parcel is back in carrier custody
risk_flags: privacy_third_party: the other household's identity, address and contacts must not be shared with the customer or anyone else; recovery stays with the carrier's recovery team
No arrival time or outcome may be promised until the carrier confirms one

authority_map.party: Plover Arc Logistics (delivery investigations / recovery team)
authority_map.controls: Contacting the third-party household, collecting the parcel, redelivering it to the verified address, recovery scans
Confirming her delivery preferences; she has asked for redelivery to her verified address
Coordination only; no access to or disclosure of third-party details

wait_check.new_since_last_promise: The desk has made no earlier promise. Event 001 (carrier located the parcel) and event 002 (customer asks for carrier-managed recovery) are both new.

plan.decision_summary: Ask Plover Arc Logistics delivery investigations by Email to have their recovery team collect DL-026 from the wrong stop and redeliver it to the customer's verified address, with no third-party details disclosed, and to confirm the collection and redelivery dates and the recovery scan.
plan.rationale: The carrier has found the parcel, and only its recovery team is allowed to contact the other household, so the carrier owns the next step: collection and redelivery. The customer has already said what she wants, so we do not need anything more from her. One request to the carrier team that wrote to us, on the channel they used, moves the case on and keeps the other household's details private.

actions.subject: DL-026 – request for recovery from wrong stop and redelivery to verified address
actions.purpose: Ask the carrier, who owns recovery, to collect the misdelivered parcel and redeliver it
actions.body:
Hello Delivery investigations team,

Thank you for your email of 2026-02-27 09:00 UTC confirming that DL-026 was handed over at the wrong stop and that you have located the sealed parcel.

The intended recipient has asked that the carrier collect the parcel and deliver it to her verified address on file for DL-026. She does not wish to contact the other household. Please could your recovery team:
1. Collect the parcel from the wrong stop, keeping all contact with that household within your recovery team.
2. Redeliver it to the verified delivery address on file for DL-026.
3. Confirm to us, within today's working day if possible, the planned collection date and time, the redelivery date, and the scan once the parcel is back in your custody.

Please do not send us any details of the other household. We do not need them and will not pass anything to the recipient.

This is a request, not a confirmation of any arrangement.

Kind regards,
Iona Quill
Rivet Delivery Desk

actions.purpose: Carrier_ops queue rule: response within the working day
actions.body: Check whether Plover Arc Logistics delivery investigations has confirmed a collection date and time, a redelivery date and a recovery scan for DL-026. If they have, update Neris Fawn through the Customer portal with only what the carrier confirmed. If there is no reply, chase delivery investigations by Email.

not_doing: Not asking for, storing or passing on any details of the other household (name, address, contacts), to protect third-party privacy
Not asking the customer to contact or collect from the other household, which she has declined
Not promising the customer a collection or redelivery date or time; the carrier has not given one
Not treating 'located' as recovered; we need a recovery scan for that
Not sending the customer an update yet; there is no cutoff and nothing new confirmed to tell her. She will be updated once the carrier confirms
plan.follow_up: At 2026-02-27 17:00 UTC, check for the carrier's confirmed collection time, redelivery date and recovery scan. If confirmed, update Neris Fawn through the Customer portal with those details only. If there is no reply, chase delivery investigations by Email. If there is still no recovery scan the next working day, ask for an investigation review.

review_rounds.plan_summary: Ask Plover Arc Logistics delivery investigations by Email to have their recovery team collect DL-026 from the wrong stop and redeliver it to the customer's verified address, with no third-party details disclosed, and to confirm the collection and redelivery dates and the recovery scan.

issues.problem: The customer escalated through the portal and gets no acknowledgement until the carrier replies. It would be a new fact for her that the desk has asked the carrier's recovery team to collect and redeliver.
issues.fix: Optionally send a short portal acknowledgement saying the request has gone to the carrier's recovery team and that no date is confirmed yet. Do not include any third-party details or ETAs.

review.summary: The plan sends the right request to the party that controls it: the carrier's delivery investigations team, by email. The message sticks to the record, keeps the other household's details private, and doesn't treat "located" as "recovered". The wait check is correct and the same-day follow-up is sensible.
